'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Scott Lingrell LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
